column1: # Single source of truth for both disasm.py and TMC0501.cpp.
# Templates use {b} = bit number, {a} = arg nibble.
# Run: python3 tools/disasm.py --emit-cpp  to regenerate C++ arrays.
# Field mask names, indexed 0..F by opcode bits 11-8.
# Entries marked <...> are handled by special-case branches in the disassembler.
# Destination / exchange register names, indexed 0..7 by opcode bits 2-0.
# BCD immediate constant N associated with each field mask, indexed 0..F.
# Branch mnemonic indexed by carry condition bit (bit 11).
# Flag-register operations, indexed 0..F by opcode bits 3-0.
# Hi nibble of opcode is the bit number {b}.
# Control / wait operations when hi nibble = A; lo nibble = index; {a} = arg nibble.
# Indices 6, 8, E, F are handled by dedicated branches — not listed here.
# Printer / card-reader operations; lo nibble = 8, hi nibble = A; index = bits 7-4.
# Library / no-op operations; lo nibble = E, hi nibble = A; index = bits 7-4.
# Hardware store / recall; lo nibble = F, hi nibble = A; index = bit 4.
